correctness.rationale: The tensor spectral decomposition gives all kernel entries exactly, conservation and positive diagonal. On excluded products, the Laplacian Green formula makes a nearest-neighbor pseudoinverse entry strictly positive; the asymptotic Gauss rational identity forces eventual negativity. On one-factor products strict positivity follows from the scalar filter. The three remaining two-factor cases have nine positive polynomial certificates. Exact-rational verifier replay yielded VERIFY_OK: 9 polynomials, 320 kernel values, 55 row sums, 246 Green identities, 243 sign checks, 12 negative witnesses. Finite tests are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp all-parameter boundary for positivity preservation across arbitrary heterogeneous Cartesian products of clique networks is a structural result of direct relevance to numerical graph heat evolution. The nearest-neighbor Green-function criterion explains every excluded case, while the mixed six-state and nine-state positive graph cases show that general method-wide positivity failures do not settle the structured family. Neither arbitrary slices nor small numerical gains are the object; this is a natural exact classification.
